candidate.source_evidence_span: In mice exposed to an excessive phosphate intake (1–2% inorganic phosphate in the diet) for 12 weeks, circulating levels of FGF23 were increased and led to a suppression of phosphate reabsorption in the renal tubules, which in turn raised the phosphate concentration in the tubule fluid (Shi - izaki et al. 2021).
